title: pr-pane 0.5.0: merge-readiness gates, branch view and /prs diagram
summary: Draw merge readiness as gates and the branch's ahead/behind in the detail view, and export both as Mermaid.
description: Jeremy asked (relayed by evolv-marketplace) for diagrams after 0.4.0: a native box-drawing gates view built from the 0.4.0 rules, a branch view from the compare API, and /prs diagram <n> producing Mermaid that can be copied or posted as a PR comment. No mmdc or Chromium: the terminal has no Svg element and Image works only in kitty or Ghostty.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The detail view draws approvals, CODEOWNERS (when required), checks, up to date and mergeable as gates joined by arrows; met gates are green, the first blocker red, later blockers dim
The gates fit bodyColumns: one row when they fit, a vertical list when the pane is narrow
The detail view shows the head branch ahead and behind its base from the compare API, cached per head commit

/prs diagram <n> returns a Mermaid flowchart of the gates and of the branch and copies it to the clipboard; with --post it posts it as a PR comment in a mermaid fence and logs the action; without --post nothing is posted
Tests cover gate order and colours, the narrow wrap, the Mermaid text from fixtures, and --post posting and logging only when given; validate --strict, plugin test and tsc pass

implementationNotes: AC1/AC2: tests/diagram.test.ts checks gate order and tones from fixtures (blocker, pending, pending, met, met; all met), the fallbacks without rules (review required, no review needed, changes requested, behind base, draft, conflicts) and gateRows at 68 and 67 columns for the 68-column chain. tests/pane.test.ts mounts the pane at 80 and 40 columns: one chain row, or └▶ rows. A gateRows that always returns one row fails 2 tests.

AC3: the mounted pane shows 'dev ◀── 3 behind · 5 ahead ── feat/x' from the compare stub. Live headless run in evolv-marketplace on PR #26 got '1 ahead · 0 behind' from the real compare API. Cached per <repo>#<base>...<head sha> with the 10-minute RULES_TTL_MS, because the base can move.

AC4: the pane test checks that /prs diagram 7 prints fenced Mermaid, copies it and posts nothing; a bad flag prints the usage; --post runs 'gh pr comment 7 --body <mermaid>' once and /prs log shows 'post diagram ok' at abc1234. Forcing isPost, or dropping the record call, each fails 1 test. Live headless run of /prs diagram 26 (print only, nothing posted) loaded the PR directly because the list wasn't loaded yet, and reported the clipboard as 'Not copied: no-surface'.

AC5: diagram.test.ts compares the full Mermaid text to an exact expected string (the snapshot). 47/47 tests, tsc 0 errors, validate --strict, lore check clean. Not verified: no renderer has validated the Mermaid syntax, and nothing was posted to a real PR.
